facts.fact: UNDP's April-June 2025 report says the project "initiated development of the National Digital Transformation Strategy" and that work "has commenced", with the Department of E-Government under the Ministry of Information and Digitalization to produce the Strategy and Roadmap in the third quarter of 2025; no adoption is reported.

The report places development of the National Digital Transformation Strategy inside the UNDP-run IDT4M project (basket fund, 1 March 2024 to 28 February 2028; 2025 work plan USD 3,165,000 for the whole project), with the strategy 'supported by the IDT4M project'; it states no government budget line for the strategy.
